meta.description: Web frontend project development rules. Use this skill when developing web frontend pages, deploying static hosting, and integrating CloudBase Web SDK.

copy.tagline: 开发并部署前端页面，集成云开发SDK
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发Web前端项目并需要部署到静态托管
copy.tagline_en: Develop and deploy frontend pages with CloudBase SDK integration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building web frontend projects and need static hosting deployment

howto.what: Claude 会按照项目结构规范组织前端代码（src、dist、cloudfunctions），使用 CloudBase Web SDK 实现认证（短信等），并构建和部署静态网站到 CloudBase 静态托管。
howto.when: 当用户需要开发 Web 前端页面、部署静态网站或集成 CloudBase Web SDK 时触发。

say.text: 将构建好的前端项目部署到 CloudBase 静态托管。
say.note: Claude 会构建并部署到非根目录。

say.text: 用 SMS 登录方式实现用户认证。
say.note: Claude 会使用 SDK 内置认证，不写云函数。

howto.what_en: Claude will organize frontend code per project structure conventions (src, dist, cloudfunctions), use CloudBase Web SDK for authentication (SMS etc.), and build/deploy static sites to CloudBase static hosting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user needs to develop web frontend pages, deploy static websites, or integrate CloudBase Web SDK.

say_en.text: Create a Vite-based frontend project and integrate CloudBase Web SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will initialize the project and install the SDK.

say_en.text: Deploy the built frontend project to CloudBase static hosting.
say_en.note: Claude will build and deploy to a non-root directory.

say_en.text: Implement user authentication with SMS login.
say_en.note: Claude will use SDK built-in auth, not cloud functions.
